formation.quote: The first co-spokesmen for the SNO collaboration when it was established in 1984

intervals.label: collaboration active
intervals.note: End taken as the D2O-drain date (2007-05), when the SNO experiment as such concluded and the site was refitted for SNO+. The same Milestones page also lists result releases in June 2008 (NCD phase) and May 2013 (combined three-phase results), so analysis by the collaboration continued after the drain date; no source states a formal end of the collaboration.
intervals.quote: The first co-spokesmen for the SNO collaboration when it was established in 1984

intervals.label: collaboration completed
intervals.note: Terminal event recorded at the D2O-drain date (the Milestones page also lists result releases in 2008 and 2013; no formal end of the collaboration is stated).
intervals.quote: May 2007 -- D2O drained from acrylic vessel

leadership.note: The official homepage names 'Professor Herb Chen from U California, Irvine and Professor George Ewan, Queen's University' as initial co-spokesmen in 1984.

country_count.note: Counted as the three distinct countries (Canada, USA, UK) named in the parenthetical locations of the 13 listed active institutions (5 in Canada, 7 in the USA, 1 in the UK); the page does not state a country count.
country_count.quote: Queen's University (Ontario, Canada) ... Los Alamos National Laboratory (New Mexico, USA) ... Oxford University (Oxford, UK)

institution_count.note: Counted directly from the official institutions page's list (Queen's, Carleton, Guelph, Laurentian, UBC, Penn, LANL, LBNL, U. Washington, Oxford, BNL, UT Austin, MIT); the page itself gives no single summary sentence stating a count. The quote gives the first and last entries of that list of 13. The page footer says it was last revised Jan 25, 2008.
institution_count.quote: Queen's University (Ontario, Canada) ... Massachusetts Institute of Technology (Massachusetts, USA)

name: SNO Collaboration
notes: The institutions page also lists four institutions that participated only until specific earlier years (Chalk River Laboratories, National Research Council of Canada, UC Irvine, Princeton University); these are not counted in `institution_count`, which reflects only the 13 listed as 'active'.

summary.plain: The international team, formed in 1984 and based mainly at Queen's University, that built and ran the SNO experiment in a Canadian mine.
summary.technical: SNO Collaboration, established 1984 (initial co-spokesmen Herb Chen, UC Irvine, and George Ewan, Queen's University); 13 active member institutions across Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom per the official institutions page.
